title: The Tailwise Training Satisfaction Guarantee: Free Repeat Allowances by Course
content:
Under the Tailwise Training Satisfaction Guarantee, a dog that has attended the sessions of certain Tailwise Training courses may repeat the same course free of charge. The schedule below states, for every course and pack, whether the free repeat is offered, the attendance it calls for, the window in which the repeat must start and how many free repeats one original enrollment allows.

| Course or pack | Free repeat of the same course | Share of scheduled sessions attended (makeups counting) | Calendar days after completion within which the repeat must start | Free repeats per original enrollment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Puppy Training 6-Week Group | Offered | 100% | 90 | 1 |
| Adult Basic Training 6-Week Group | Offered | 100% | 90 | 1 |
| Intermediate Training 6-Week Group | Offered | 100% | 90 | 1 |
| Advanced Training & CGC Prep 6-Week Group | Not offered | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Private Training 4-Session Pack | Not offered | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Private Training 8-Session Pack | Not offered | 0 | 0 | 0 |

**What the schedule says in plain terms**

The Puppy Training 6-Week Group, the Adult Basic Training 6-Week Group and the Intermediate Training 6-Week Group each offer one free repeat per original enrollment, for a dog that attended 100% of the scheduled sessions, makeups counting, with the repeat starting within 90 calendar days after the original course was completed. The Advanced Training & CGC Prep 6-Week Group and both Private Training packs do not offer a free repeat; their attendance share, window and repeat count are shown as 0.

**Illustration (hypothetical enrollment).** On a 6-session Adult Basic Training 6-Week Group, 100% of the scheduled sessions is all 6. A dog that attended 5 sessions in class and made up the sixth in another class counts as having attended 6.
